wars.name: Revolt of Aristonicus
wars.outcome: Roman victory: Crassus Mucianus was defeated and killed after trying to retake Leucae, Perperna beat Aristonicus in 130 and he was strangled at Rome in 129; Ariarathes V of Cappadocia, Mithridates V of Pontus, Nicomedes II of Bithynia and Pylaemenes of…

certainty.note: Only named cities are known; there is no frontier.
